title: Memory Optimization: Generator vs List
description: Day 14: list comprehension vs generator expression.

scenes.heading: Big lists eat RAM
scenes.narration: Today we look at a simple line of Python that can quietly use eighty megabytes of memory.

scenes.heading: A list comprehension
scenes.narration: This line builds every number at once and stores them all in memory.

scenes.heading: Generator vs list
scenes.narration: Swap the square brackets for parentheses, and Python makes a generator that yields one value at a time.
scenes.tip: Use a generator when you only need to loop over the values once.

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.narration: Use generators for large data, and subscribe for tomorrow's lesson on Day 15.
